title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
text_note: Original demo descriptions inspired by the book, not verbatim excerpts. French edition translated by Henri Bué.

scenes.title: The White Rabbit
scenes.text: A white rabbit in a waistcoat looks at a golden pocket watch beside a rabbit hole in a flowering meadow.

scenes.title: The Cheshire Cat
scenes.text: A grinning striped cat rests on a twisting tree branch above a woodland path in a mysterious forest.

scenes.title: The Tea Party
scenes.text: A man wearing an oversized top hat and a hare sit at a long outdoor tea table covered in mismatched teacups beneath flowering trees.

scenes.title: Le croquet de la Reine
scenes.spoken_example: La Reine joue au croquet avec un flamant rose.
scenes.text: A queen in a red heart-patterned gown holds a pink flamingo like a croquet mallet on a green lawn surrounded by rose bushes.
